experiments.description: Four placed components from three generic recipes: two initial SignalSource patterns, one GuideSegment, and one Receiver. The fixed +++ tensor and all initial data are chosen before evolution. An arrival-driven record and counter magnitude are observed; free counter phase rotation between arrivals is not another incoming signal.

provenance.observation_policy: Read-only; no state or coupling intervention.
